payload.title: Suppress repeated Chromium fullscreen notices without losing presentation mode

expectation.text: When cycling between fullscreen Chromium windows, avoid a new exit-fullscreen notice while retaining true presentation fullscreen with tabs and toolbar hidden.

payload.observed: Chromium could display its built-in exit-fullscreen notice again when focus returned to a fullscreen browser window. The journal describes this as an optional presentation preference, not a documented Omarchy regression.
